question: Who defeated Prithviraj Chauhan in the second battle of Tarain in 1192 AD?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad Ghori**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Second Battle of Tarain.
 
 
• The Second Battle of Tarian (Taraori) was again fought between the Ghurid army of Mohammed Ghori and the Rajput army of Prithviraj Chauhan.
 
• The battle took place in 1192 A.D near Tarain. In this battle, Prithviraj Chauhan was defeated by Mohammed Ghori.
 
• The Second Battle of Tarain is regarded as a turning point in the history of India as it resulted in Muslim conquest of India.
 
• Muhammad Ghori appointed Qutb-ud-din Aybakas his viceroy of his territories in India.
